import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, itertools, re
from collections import defaultdict
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# ---------------- recompute everything needed for one composite figure ----------------
RAD={'C':1.70,'N':1.55,'O':1.52,'S':1.80}
RING={'PHE':['CG','CD1','CD2','CE1','CE2','CZ'],'TYR':['CG','CD1','CD2','CE1','CE2','CZ'],
      'TRP':['CD2','CE2','CE3','CZ2','CZ3','CH2','CG','CD1','NE1'],'HIS':['CG','ND1','CD2','CE1','NE2']}
m3={'PHE':'F','TYR':'Y','TRP':'W','HIS':'H'}
def parse(t,chains):
    out=[];on=True
    for l in t.splitlines():
        if l.startswith("MODEL"): on=(int(l.split()[1])==1)
        if l.startswith("ENDMDL"): on=False
        if not on or not l.startswith("ATOM") or l[16] not in (" ","A"): continue
        if l[21] not in chains: continue
        el=(l[76:78].strip() or l[12:16].strip()[0]).upper()
        if el in ("H","D"): continue
        out.append(dict(name=l[12:16].strip(),resn=l[17:20].strip(),resi=int(l[22:26]),el=el,
                        xyz=(float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54]))))
    return out
def sasa(at,n=960,p=1.4):
    x=np.array([a['xyz'] for a in at]); r=np.array([RAD.get(a['el'],1.8) for a in at])+p
    i=np.arange(n)+0.5; ph=np.arccos(1-2*i/n); th=np.pi*(1+5**0.5)*i
    sp=np.c_[np.cos(th)*np.sin(ph),np.sin(th)*np.sin(ph),np.cos(ph)]
    d=np.linalg.norm(x[:,None]-x[None],axis=-1); o=np.zeros(len(at))
    for k in range(len(at)):
        nb=np.where((d[k]<r[k]+r)&(np.arange(len(at))!=k))[0]; pts=x[k]+r[k]*sp
        acc=(np.linalg.norm(pts[:,None]-x[nb][None],axis=-1)>=r[nb][None]).all(1) if len(nb) else np.ones(n,bool)
        o[k]=4*np.pi*r[k]**2*acc.mean()
    return o
def ringtab(pid,chains):
    t=requests.get("https://files.rcsb.org/download/%s.pdb"%pid,timeout=120).text
    at=parse(t,chains); s=sasa(at); nres=len({(a['resi']) for a in at})
    rr=defaultdict(lambda:{'s':0.,'xyz':[]})
    for a,v in zip(at,s):
        if a['resn'] in RING and a['name'] in RING[a['resn']]:
            k=(a['resi'],a['resn']); rr[k]['s']+=v; rr[k]['xyz'].append(a['xyz'])
    com=np.mean([a['xyz'] for a in at],axis=0)
    rows=[]
    for k,d in rr.items():
        P=np.array(d['xyz']); c=P.mean(0); _,_,vt=np.linalg.svd(P-c)
        rows.append(dict(resi=k[0],resn=k[1],lab=m3[k[1]]+str(k[0]),ring=d['s'],cen=c,nrm=vt[2],
                         outv=(c-com)/np.linalg.norm(c-com)))
    return pd.DataFrame(rows).sort_values('resi'), nres
d23,n23=ringtab('4ZCE',['A']); tcy,ntc=ringtab('1DQC',['A']); chb,nch=ringtab('1ED7',['A'])

# CBM14 register conservation
def up_fasta(q,size=500):
    r=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search",params={'query':q,'size':size,'format':'fasta'},timeout=120)
    s={};n=None
    for l in r.text.split("\n"):
        if l.startswith(">"): n=l[1:]; s[n]=""
        elif n: s[n]+=l.strip()
    return s
pool=up_fasta('(xref:pfam-PF01607) AND (taxonomy_id:6933) AND (length:[40 TO 200])')
CAN=re.compile(r"C(.{10,22})C(.{3,8})C(.{6,14})C(.{8,20})C(.{3,12})C")
AROM=set("FYWH"); cols=defaultdict(list); ncan=0
for nm,s in pool.items():
    m=CAN.search(s)
    if not m: continue
    ncan+=1
    for blk,g in zip(('C1','C2','C3'),(m.group(1),m.group(2),m.group(3))):
        for o,res in enumerate(g,1): cols[(blk,o)].append(res)
DERP23="MKFNIIIVFISLAILVHSSYAANDNDDDPTTTVHPTTTEQPDDKFECPSRFGYFADPKDPHKFYICSNWEAVHKDCPGNTRWNEDEETCT"
reg=[(('C1',o),47+o) for o in range(1,14)]+[(('C2',o),61+o) for o in range(1,5)]+[(('C3',o),66+o) for o in range(1,10)]
ringmap={r.resi:r.ring for _,r in d23.iterrows()}
cons=[]
for k,pos in reg:
    v=cols.get(k,[])
    if len(v)<100: continue
    aa=DERP23[pos-1]
    cons.append(dict(key="%s+%d"%k,pos=pos,aa=aa,freq=sum(x in AROM for x in v)/len(v),
                     arom=aa in AROM,ring=ringmap.get(pos,np.nan)))
C=pd.DataFrame(cons)

# ---------------- figure ----------------
fig=plt.figure(figsize=(16,9))
gs=fig.add_gridspec(2,3,height_ratios=[1,1.05],hspace=0.55,wspace=0.28)

ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,0])
dens=pd.Series({'Der p 23\n(4ZCE)':100*d23.ring.sum()/n23,'Tachycitin\n(1DQC)':100*tcy.ring.sum()/ntc,
                'ChBD ChiA1\n(1ED7)':100*chb.ring.sum()/nch})
ax.bar(dens.index,dens.values,color=['#c53030','#2f855a','#2b6cb0'])
for i,v in enumerate(dens.values): ax.text(i,v+20,"%.0f"%v,ha='center',fontsize=10)
ax.set_ylabel("Exposed aromatic ring SASA\nper 100 residues (A$^2$)")
ax.set_title("Der p 23 is not depleted of exposed aromatics")

ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,1:])
w=0.38
ax.bar(np.arange(len(d23))-w/2,d23.ring,w,label='Der p 23 (4ZCE)',color='#c53030')
ax.set_xticks(np.arange(len(d23))); ax.set_xticklabels(d23.lab,rotation=0)
ax.axhline(15,ls='--',c='k',lw=.8)
ax.set_ylabel("Ring SASA (A$^2$)"); ax.legend(frameon=False,loc='upper left')
ax.set_title("Der p 23 aromatic rings: 8 of 10 solvent exposed; W69 is the most exposed (106 A$^2$)")

ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,0])
ex=d23[d23.ring>=15]
P=[];L=[]
for a,b in itertools.combinations(ex.itertuples(),2):
    dist=np.linalg.norm(a.cen-b.cen); ang=np.degrees(np.arccos(min(1,abs(np.dot(a.nrm,b.nrm)))))
    face=np.degrees(np.arccos(min(1,np.dot(a.outv,b.outv))))
    P.append((dist,ang,face<70)); L.append(a.lab+"-"+b.lab)
P=np.array(P,dtype=object)
dd=np.array([p[0] for p in P],float); aa=np.array([p[1] for p in P],float); ff=np.array([p[2] for p in P],bool)
ax.scatter(dd[~ff],aa[~ff],c='#cbd5e0',s=30,label='opposite faces')
ax.scatter(dd[ff],aa[ff],c='#c53030',s=45,label='same face')
ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((6,0),7,40,fc='#fffaf0',ec='#dd6b20',ls='--',zorder=0))
for i,l in enumerate(L):
    if ff[i] and 6<=dd[i]<=13 and aa[i]<40: ax.annotate(l,(dd[i],aa[i]),fontsize=8,xytext=(3,3),textcoords='offset points')
ax.set_xlabel("ring centroid distance (A)"); ax.set_ylabel("angle between ring planes (deg)")
ax.set_title("Der p 23 exposed aromatics:\nF51/F54/W69 form a near coplanar same-face patch",fontsize=11)
ax.legend(frameon=False,fontsize=8)

ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,1:])
xs=np.arange(len(C))
ax.bar(xs,C.freq,color=['#c53030' if a else '#cbd5e0' for a in C.arom])
for i,r in enumerate(C.itertuples()):
    txt="%s%d"%(r.aa,r.pos)+("" if np.isnan(r.ring) else " (%.0f A$^2$)"%r.ring)
    ax.text(i,r.freq+0.03,txt,ha='center',fontsize=7,rotation=90,
            color='#c53030' if r.arom else '#4a5568')
ax.set_xticks(xs); ax.set_xticklabels(C.key,rotation=90,fontsize=7)
ax.set_ylim(0,1.35); ax.set_ylabel("fraction aromatic in %d Acari\ncanonical CBM14 domains"%ncan)
ax.set_title("Aromatic conservation by CBM14 cysteine register. Red = aromatic in Der p 23, ring SASA in brackets.\n"
             "The single strongly conserved aromatic (C2+3, 92%%) is Y64, which is buried (11 A$^2$).",fontsize=10)
plt.show()
print(C.to_string(index=False,float_format=lambda x:"%.2f"%x))
print("\nncan",ncan,"of",len(pool))
